verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an official, agent-agnostic, self-hostable MCP server built on its open plugin API. Its docs say AI agents can read and interact with design files because design is expressed as code. An integrations API with access tokens also gives broad access to objects and properties, and the AI workflows page mentions connecting tokens to implementation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of exposing frames, variables, screenshots/rendered images and component-to-code mappings through the MCP server; independent or hands-on corroboration that agents implement designs from it; published API reference (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
